findings.summary: A cost-bearing OpenRouter response with prompt_tokens_details explicitly null (not missing) raises AttributeError after cost_usd > 0 is established but before record_cost() is called, silently dropping a legitimate CostEntry.
findings.recommended_fix: Guard each chained .get() against explicit None (e.g. `usage.get("prompt_tokens_details") or {}`), not just missing keys, for token_usage/cost/prompt_tokens_details. Add a regression test with prompt_tokens_details: None asserting a CostEntry is still written.

findings.summary: The debug/warning split relies on whether an exception happens to be raised, not on the actual data shape, so a None in the usage/cost chain can turn the 'expected silent no-cost' case into warning-level log noise instead of the intended silent else branch.
findings.recommended_fix: Fix B1 first, then confirm the expected-no-cost path (cost_data None or {}) resolves to cost_usd == 0 and hits the silent else branch rather than the except branch.

findings.summary: Pre-existing (out of scope) cost cap silently rewrites any single cost above $1000 to exactly $1000 before persisting it, feeding an inaccurate number into all downstream rollups.
findings.recommended_fix: Not requested in this PR; flagged for awareness since it sits on this feature's only write path.

findings.summary: model=metadata.get("model_name", component) falls back to the component name (e.g. 'task_enrichment') rather than None/'unknown' if model_name is ever absent from a cost-bearing response.
findings.recommended_fix: Low priority / effectively unreachable given OpenRouter always includes model_name. No action requested.

findings.summary: Provider selection is an if/elif chain mixing low-level per-provider details into one method rather than a per-provider strategy object.
findings.recommended_fix: Not touched by this feature (explicitly out of scope per architecture.md); no action requested.

scope_note: Feature diff is limited to a one-line log-level change (debug->warning) in _invoke_and_record plus 4 new tests; all other cost-tracking machinery is pre-existing and explicitly out of scope per docs/architecture.md section 3. Findings above trace to the extraction logic this diff touches and the write path it feeds.
